title: v0.30.1
body:
> v0.30.1 is the next minor release.
>
> **Timetable**: to be announced.

## 👉 Changelog

[compare changes](https://github.com/agntn/puzzles/compare/v0.30.0...v0.30.1)

### 🚀 Enhancements

- **collections:** add 9vw04 (#537)
- **rushwallet:** solve wallet 26 (#536)
- **collections:** add weave riddles (#535)
- **tools:** add ChatGPT @ mentions (#533)
- **tools:** fold long stage lists (#532)
- **collections:** add zden/demobit-2018 thread (#525)
- **collections:** add zden/level-xm17 thread (#524)

### 🩹 Fixes

- **collections:** fund bits/1 in 2015 (#538)

### 💅 Refactors

- write coin amounts in one spot (#531)
- move prize sums out of format (#530)
- lift extensions out (#527)
- rename core/utils to format (#526)

### 🏡 Chore

- **docs:** move to Nuxt 4.6 (#534)

### 🤖 CI

- release through uppt (#528)

### ❤️ Contributors

- aeitwoen (@aeitwoen)
- Ori (@oritwoen)

title: feat(collections): add 9vw04
body: `9vw04` joins the collection: Gem Finder's 0.02 BTC puzzle, a coloured grid and a professed dislike of rainbows. The prize is still unspent as of October 17, 2026.
